title: Pusha T Receives Ultimate Praise From Seven-Time Super Bowl Champion Tom Brady
htmlContent:
During a literal promotion race for its brand Brady "Run" clothing line, TB12 used Pusha T and Kanye IAD's collaboration "Dreaming of the Past" while jokingly boasting about being the fastest QB in the NFL.

"You don’t rack up over 1,000 career rushing yards without a little speed. The @bradybrand RUN collection is coming Thursday, get on the list now at bradybrand.com, link in bio," Brandy wrote.

Push T had one heck of a drop as he got retweeted and got TB12 to co-sign as "IAD" was indeed the album of the year. It's in their book at least.

Pusha T's "It's Almost Dry" was released in April. The album was spearheaded by the singles "Neck and Wrist" featuring Jay-Z, "Hear Me Clearly" and "Diet Coke." Kanye West, Kid Cudi, Lil Uzi Vert, Pharrell, No Malice, and Don Toliver make guest appearances on the project. He transported 55,000 units of the same album in his first week, good enough to snag the number one album on the Billboard top 200, according to XXL.com.
